description: The United Insurance Company of Pakistan Limited is a Pakistani general insurer with its head office at UIG House in Lahore and its registered office in Karachi. It writes general insurance and also operates Window Takaful business under the Tameem-United name, and it carries insurer financial strength ratings of AA+ from PACRA and VIS. It is a public interest company listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange.
headOffice: UIG House, 01, Upper Mall, Lahore, Pakistan
